reviewSamples.author: Photo of Linda Mancini
reviewSamples.text: Fantastic job on my truck and trailer! They look like brand new! Got back to me quickly after initial text and came right out and did a super job with a smile! Highly recommend!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mona Preece-Davis
reviewSamples.text: They just recently detailed a Box truck van that had not been taken care of in quite some time. It looks incredible, and Willie was the first company to call me back and fit us in quickly. We will definitely be using him again for both our company and personal vehicles.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Vincent Cevasco
reviewSamples.text: William's work is amazing. I was hoping it was even cleanable & he proved more than I could have imagined, it is and WOW WOW WOW. This man worked a miracle & I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND to all. He has true integrity.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Gus Barres
reviewSamples.text: Great work! Passed my wife's inspection

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Michael Ballard
reviewSamples.text: William Garcia is a really awesome dude came in Ridenow and got himself a bike definitely deserves it and he does amazing detailing work you should definitely check him out for really good guy to work with and talk to appreciate you for swinging by enjoy the bike
